title: Official blog review decisions stage 13
summary: This iteration adds an internal AI review decision normalizer for OpenAI and Anthropic official-blog review packets. It validates AI responses against packet intake ids and the admission policy, keeps raw AI output and queue internals out of the artifact, and ensures deterministic needs_review customer or partnership stories cannot be auto-promoted to authoring without manual review.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog review decisions|official-blog:review-decisions" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: AI review output needs its own normalized boundary before any authoring step.
lessons.evidence: Stage 13 adds `official_blog_review_decisions` with accepted, manual-review, excluded, and invalid decision buckets keyed by packet `intake_id`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the decision artifact, not raw AI output, when moving official-blog candidates toward manual authoring.

lessons.lesson: Customer or partnership stories with implementation hints still need manual reading.
lessons.evidence: Deterministic `needs_review` packet items remain under `needs_manual_review` even when the AI returns `include`.
lessons.recommended_action: Do not turn customer or partnership stories into curated records until a human confirms reusable implementation value beyond the preview.

lessons.lesson: Decision artifacts must not preserve raw AI transcripts or private source context.
lessons.evidence: Tests prove raw body text, raw transcript text, source audit, candidate pool fields, and public-rendering internals do not appear in decision payloads.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep decision output compact and internal; public pages should only consume reviewed curated records.

suggestions.issue: Review packets could be sent to AI, but there was no safe, schema-like return boundary for AI decisions before authoring.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 13 adds `createOfficialBlogReviewDecisions` and `official-blog:review-decisions`, plus tests for auto-promotion blocking, duplicate/unknown/missing decisions, policy-invalid criteria, and public output guards.
suggestions.suggestion: Require all AI review responses to pass through the review-decision normalizer before any manual translation or curated-record drafting.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The official-blog workflow can accept high-value model/product/engineering posts while preventing low-signal company news and borderline customer stories from bypassing review.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through pure function and CLI coverage, with public output guards and internal payload sanitization.
validation_evidence: official blog review decisions normalize AI output without auto-promoting manual review
official blog review decisions reject policy-invalid criteria and missing decisions
official blog review-decisions CLI writes clean internal AI review decisions
official blog review-decisions CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add a manual authoring handoff schema that turns accepted decision items into translation/summary tasks without copying AI decision internals into curated records.
Wire live official-blog discovery to feed preview packets and decision artifacts once the source-fetch stage is implemented.
